cards.title: isInvestmentGrade(rating) in src/ratings/notch.mjs
cards.context: Add one named export isInvestmentGrade(rating) to src/ratings/notch.mjs: return indexOf(rating) <= 9 (strict boolean) using the module's existing private indexOf, so normalisation (String(x ?? '').trim().toUpperCase()) and the RangeError 'unknown rating: ${JSON.stringify(rating)}' are identical to notchChange. Do not touch RATING_SCALE, indexOf, notchChange or notchCalculator. Plain Node ESM, no dependencies, pure function (CLAUDE.md). Dev unit tests go in a NEW file test/unit/ratings/investmentGrade.test.mjs (node:test + node:assert/strict); do not edit existing test files. Note: test/integration/ratings/notch.int.test.mjs line 17 (export list) will fail until QA updates it, which is expected and belongs to QA (readiness PRD-conflicts (a)).
acceptance: AC-1: isInvestmentGrade returns true for AAA..BBB- (10 ratings) and false for BB+..CCC- (9 ratings), strictly boolean
AC-2: boundary BBB- -> true, BB+ -> false
AC-3: ' bbb- ' -> true, 'bb+' -> false, '\tAaA\n' -> true (notchChange's normalisation)
AC-4: ZZZ, '', '   ', null, undefined, 'D', 'NR', 'BBB -', 5 throw RangeError 'unknown rating: <JSON>' identical to notchChange
AC-5: exports sorted = [RATING_SCALE, isInvestmentGrade, notchCalculator, notchChange]; existing behaviour and suite unchanged except the export-list assertion
